result.title: A Hybrid State Space-Attention Architecture for Forecasting the Trajectories of Battery Degradation
result.summary: Early-life battery degradation trajectory forecasting aims to predict a battery cell's full state-of-health (SOH) trajectory from its initial charge-discharge cycles, potentially reducing cell qualification and evaluation time from months to days. Despite recent advances, accurate forecasting remains challenging for emerging battery chemistries, data-scarce domains, and cells exhibiting degradation behaviors beyond those observed during training. Existing state-of-the-art approaches increasingly rely on model scaling, large language model-derived aging-condition embeddings, and extensive fold-specific hyperparameter tuning, raising concerns about computational efficiency, reproducibility, and generalization. This work introduces DecayFormer, a compact hybrid state-space and attention architecture designed for early-life degradation trajectory forecasting. DecayFormer combines cycle-level selective recurrence, using a single scalar state per channel, with an attention mechanism queried by the recurrent state. It further incorporates state-of-charge (SOC) interval statistics and a master curve head that jointly estimates a scalar lifetime and a monotonically non-increasing SOH profile parameterized by normalized lifetime. We evaluate DecayFormer on the BatteryLife benchmark using all 22 aging-condition-exclusive folds, with a single run per fold and one fixed configuration across all folds, without fold-specific tuning. DecayFormer achieves mean test MAPE values of 2.25% on Li-ion, 2.76% on CALB, 0.95% on Na-ion, and 7.19% on Zn-ion. These results demonstrate the potential of compact sequence models to deliver accurate early-life degradation forecasts across diverse battery chemistries and aging conditions, without relying on extensive model scaling or per-fold optimization.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 DecayFormer，一个紧凑的混合状态空间-注意力架构，用于从早期充放电循环预测电池完整 SOH 退化轨迹：以每通道单标量状态的循环选择性更新、由循环状态作为 query 的注意力，配合 SOC 区间统计与参数化单调曲线的输出头，在 BatteryLife 基准全部 22 个折上以单一固定配置评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「极紧凑循环状态 + 状态查询注意力 + 单调参数化轨迹头」可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态压缩、跨步状态更新以及带物理约束的 latent 轨迹解码；与视觉/多模态推理无直接关系，迁移仅为可能线索。
